'''May 2001 Fitchburg tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Fitchburg, MA in May 2001. [[Eric Hunter]] won it. It is known from Eric Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2331">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-20-fitchburg-f-digimond2331/ fitchburg-f-digimon], DeckTech (Eric "bounty22" Hunter, 20 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-20-fitchburg-f-digimond2331/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' May 2001
* '''Site:''' Fitchburg, MA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[Eric Hunter]]
